name: bizops-demo
description: BizOps Suite — business ops platform demo (leads, bookings, invoicing, support) across 5 role dashboards, built by Novexa IT

paragraphs: A business operations platform demo — leads, clients, bookings, tasks, invoicing, support, and reporting for a services business, viewed through five different role-based dashboards plus an external client portal.

This is a self-contained demo build. There is no backend, no database, and no API keys. All application data — 60 staff members, 500 leads, 300 clients, 300 bookings, 400 tasks, 250 invoices, 180 support tickets, and a 400-entry audit log — is generated client-side from a seeded random generator the moment the app loads, and held in plain React state for the rest of the session. Clone it, run two commands, pick a role, and every screen already has realistic, internally-consistent data to show. Read on for exactly how that's done.
features: Business Owner — Overview.tsx, Leads.tsx, Proposals.tsx, Clients.tsx, Invoices.tsx, Reports.tsx, AuditLog.tsx, Settings.tsx
Business-wide overview: new/qualified leads, pipeline value, active
clients, revenue this month, pending invoice value, and a running audit-entry count
Leads-by-source breakdown and a lead conversion funnel chart
Client status breakdown and team workload by department

whatItDoes.text: A business operations platform demo — leads, clients, bookings, tasks, invoicing, support, and reporting for a services business, viewed through five different role-based dashboards plus an external client portal.

requirements.text: No .env file, no API keys, no signup.

Four staff identities (Rohan Malhotra, Priya Iyer, Aditya Sharma, Neha Kapoor) and one client (Summit Technologies) are hard-coded ahead of the random generation specifically so the five login roles and the portal always have a stable person/company to point at:

Wiring. src/data/seed.ts calls generateDemoData() once at module load and re-exports the results as initialLeads, initialClients, etc., alongside the static roleUser and roleTabs maps that drive the login screen and tab visibility.
